title: no prediction lines on watch with aaps-client
body:
no prediction lines in CGM graph on watchface with aaps-client

Tested on version AAPS master/client verson 3.3.2.0 with Suunto 7 and Samsung Watch.

On both (master and client) app in the mobile phone prediction lines are present.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/77bbb43a-4eab-4720-9b0b-335c5f4ad1b6)

comments.body: Hi! I think it's always been like this. Is there a reason for it @Philoul ?

User should check within Watch, AAPS Settings, Graphical parameter if "Show Predictions" is enabled or not...
![Screenshot_20250521_181057_androidaps.png](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3a52019b-947c-454e-a4de-096151ff1ba2)

![Screenshot_20250521_181050_androidaps.png](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a0b2f39f-0860-4208-8d17-7d005f86c4a4)

![Screenshot_20250521_180927_androidaps.png](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1c2df325-8c6d-4c41-83c5-012447861814)

If predictions are available within AAPSClient app on phone, they should be available within watch (but never tested myself)
- this parameter has been included to allow simplication of graph view into the watch (screen is much smaller compared to phone screen)

> User should check within Watch, AAPS Settings, Graphical parameter if predictions is enabled or not... !
> If predictions are available within AAPSClient app on phone, they should be available within watch (but never tested myself)


As i wrote in incial post, in aapsclient app is prediction visibile. 

I have got reported problem from parent of T1D child and replicate  it self the problem on other 2 watches/phones.

Setting on watch checked double.
I checked on my watch connected to AAPSClient app and show predictions is turned on. There is no predictions on cwf.

Ok, so it's an issue 😉
I will try to see the trigger/information used to send predictions to the watch to understand why they are not included.

Maybe @olorinmaia you can help me if you have a test conf where you can reproduce the issue.

Fixed in dev with commit 7011790
@MilosKozak this issue can be closed.
